_meta.purpose: Identity/inquiry vendors (Shahkar-style mobile-national-ID match, card-owner, IBAN, civil registry), SMS providers (OTP) and Moadian e-invoice, with endpoint capabilities and unverified prices.
_meta.legal_note: Each inquiry processes personal data. Obtain explicit, purpose-limited consent, minimise retention (store the boolean result + vendor trace id, not the raw registry answer), and confirm the legal basis with the licensed Iranian counsel (04-legal-tax-compliance-ir). Not legal advice.
_meta.evidence_note: Endpoint shapes come from SDK source (npm/PyPI) read directly. Prices, SLAs, contracts and legal terms are NOT verified (search budget exhausted).
